wedge: home size + move type + truck/crew + distance + stairs/elevator + ladder truck + date premium + appliance/cleaning options => estimate a defensible total-cost range, then let the consumer paste 2-3 received quotes and flag unusually high/low totals and likely missing add-ons before choosing a mover; the product sells quote sanity-checking, not another lead form
last_material_result: One bounded fresh discovery generation compared several consumer-decision spaces. Generic electricity/air-conditioner bill calculators were KILLed because current Korean search results are saturated with multiple 2026 calculators already covering progressive tiers, seasonal rules, appliance usage and discounts. Generic wedding-gift calculators were also KILLed because several dedicated 2026 calculators/guides already answer the same relationship/attendance question. Moving cost survived because the decision has high monetary stakes and public competitors expose enough pricing structure to support a zero-cost estimator: current moving sites publish materially different ranges by truck/home size and explicitly note that distance, date, stairs/elevator, ladder truck and options change final price. That variance creates a stronger wedge than a generic estimator: compare actual quotes against an explainable expected range and surface likely omitted extras before the consumer commits. Competition is strong in lead-gen quote comparison, so this survives only as an independent no-phone-number sanity checker rather than another quote-request marketplace.
economics: Validation spend KRW0. A static v1 is technically plausible with no backend/login/paid API if it uses editable reference ranges and user-entered quotes. Monetary stakes are high (moving quotes commonly span hundreds of thousands to millions of KRW), creating plausible affiliate/lead-gen value later, but acquisition and monetization are unproven. Maintenance burden is moderate because reference ranges need periodic refresh; avoid pretending to provide exact market prices.

recommendation: KEEP at ASSESS for one more bounded validation. Prioritize the received-quote sanity-check + hidden-extra normalization wedge; do not build a generic moving-cost calculator and do not collect phone numbers or sell leads during incubation.
